{{Top|notoc=1}}
'''Amnesia''' was a mental condition that various beings experienced upon head trauma or other traumatic events, such as being frozen in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] for a long period of time, consuming illegal drugs, or being manipulated by [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. It varied in its degree of severity depending on the event that triggered it.
